Reporting to the assigned SEO Content Manager, you’ll work inside systems to generate, refine, and QA content across multiple publications, ensuring every piece is accurate, helpful, SEO-optimized, and delivered on schedule. You’ll translate Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), templates, and format standards into consistently excellent output at scale, while supporting freelance contributors when needed. Beyond day-to-day production, you’ll help evolve the systems behind our content by identifying edge cases, surfacing recurring issues, and sharing insights that improve prompts, templates, and workflows. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in structured processes, loves creating clear and engaging content, and is excited to help shape the next generation of AI-native editorial operations. What You’ll Be Doing (Responsibilities): Produce New Content Produce high-quality across BWZ publications using in-house automations, SOPs, templates, and formats. Maintain strong output velocity while upholding accuracy, clarity, and SEO requirements. Identify recurring issues, edge cases, or blockers and surface them to the Content Manager. Own Content Quality QA all assigned content—new and upgraded—to ensure accuracy, readability, SEO alignment, and brand consistency. Ensure visuals, CTAs, internal links, and structural elements are implemented correctly. Collaborate with the SEO Content Manager to improve the usefulness and performance of each content format and implement improvements at scale. Ensure content is useful, helpful, and relevant to the reader and goes above and beyond competing articles. How Your Success Will Be Measured: Content Production & Velocity: The volume and consistency of new content and updates you produce—measured by your ability to meet or exceed publishing targets for your assigned formats. Content Quality: The quality of the content you produce and upgrade—measured by adherence to editorial, SEO, and formatting standards, while minimizing revisions and QA issues. Your Skillset Includes: 2+ years of experience in content production, content coordination, editorial operations, or a similar role. Strong writing, editing, and QA skills with attention to accuracy, clarity, and structure. Background in SEO principles and on-page best practices (SEO writing, content marketing, or operational editorial work). Experience working with or writing about SaaS products is an asset. Ability to follow detailed SOPs, templates, and workflows with consistency and precision. Comfort using AI tools as part of a structured editorial process. Experience with WordPress. Highly organized, reliable, and able to manage multiple pieces of content simultaneously. Nice to Haves: Experience using SEO tools like Ahrefs (SEO research) and Clearscope (SEO optimization) Experience using project management tools like Airtable.

southparkcommons-pillar-space:ashbyhq:d3.description: FOUNDING LEAD AVIONICS & SOFTWARE ENGINEER Equity: 0.3% – 1% depending on experience ABOUT US We're a stealth team building space hardware at the edge of what's currently possible — high-stakes, flight-grade systems where the engineering bar is unforgiving and the upside is enormous. While we can't share full details yet, our founding and early engineering team includes talent from SpaceX, Northrop Grumman, and Impulse Space, the group includes people who've pulled off feats almost no one else on Earth has. This is a senior technical leadership role. You will not only define and execute the avionics and flight software architecture, but also help build the engineering team, set technical standards, mentor engineers, and establish the systems, processes, and culture required to develop flight-grade hardware and software. This is not a narrow board-design or coding role. You will own the full stack: avionics architecture, flight computers, C&DH, sensor and actuator interfaces, the flight software that runs on top, fault management, and the test infrastructure that proves it all works. You will make system-level trades across hardware, software, sensors, autonomy, power, and reliability. The ideal candidate has direct experience with spacecraft avionics, flight software, embedded systems, hardware bring-up, integration and test, and technical team leadership. We recognize that very few people have all of this. What matters most is that you have exceptional fundamentals, have led real systems from concept toward flight, have managed or mentored engineers in high-performance technical environments, and can operate independently in ambiguity while making sound engineering tradeoffs. You will have direct ownership over one of the company's core technical challenges.
